findings.claim: Guests retain public SEO/Data functionality without account-owned saved reads.
findings.evidence: SeoView skips saved history when authStatus is signed-out; fetchSeoAuditHistoryForUrl independently checks hasSupabaseAccessToken before extendDb(). DataView retains extraction UI and skips fetchPatternsForDomain when user is null.
findings.limit: No current-artifact/native UI run. Original 0.2.556 evidence shows global notice over Chat but does not prove that notice caused the unseen assistant reply; current source cannot establish the visual behavior on a new artifact.

findings.claim: Sign-in/out transitions clear or refresh account-owned data.
findings.evidence: SEO tests exercise signed-out→signed-in→signed-out and assert saved history appears then clears; Data test exercises guest→signed-in and observes the pattern fetch/load.
findings.limit: No DataView sign-out transition assertion exists in the added test; its requested clear-on-sign-out behavior remains source-inferred, not independently tested.

findings.detail: The sibling DataView test proves guest read suppression and sign-in refresh but does not prove pattern clearing after sign-out. Add only if implementation owner wants automated coverage of that acceptance clause.

The SEO guest tests observe the Supabase query builder (`read`) and token preflight; they are not string-only mirrors. Existing tests preserve real refusal semantics by requiring 42501 to reject as DbFailureError and exercise retry UI.
